title: Chris
text: I am currently a student in the UBC Master of Data Science program. Before MDS, I studied Statistics at the University of Ottawa. Through the MDS program, I hope to connect the mathematical theory I learned as an undergraduate with computer science and practical applications. Outside of academics, I enjoy soccer, basketball, and esports, and I also look forward to meeting new people and broadening my perspectives through the program.

title: About
text: I completed my undergraduate studies in Statistics at the University of Ottawa. During my undergraduate studies, I developed a strong foundation in mathematics, statistics, and programming. These experiences made me interested in connecting theoretical knowledge with practical problems.

title: About
text:
Why Data Science
I chose the UBC Master of Data Science program because I want to strengthen my practical skills in data analysis and computing. I am especially interested in combining the mathematical and statistical theory I learned during my undergraduate studies with computer science tools and real-world applications. I also hope to explore new areas of data science and better understand how these skills are used in practice.

text:
Outside of Data Science
Outside of academics, I enjoy soccer, basketball, and esports. Sports and gaming are some of the main ways I relax in my free time. I also enjoy meeting new people, exploring new places, and learning from people with different backgrounds and experiences.
